desc: 泥状质地雾面成膜，唇颊两用，色号一律由强调色占位承载
leaf: 空气感泥状雾面唇颊两用唇泥
name: 空气感泥状雾面显色唇泥款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用开盖立管、抽出的刷头与身后一大片雾面泥状色块同时交代器形与哑光质地
承接主图，用满幅斜向泥状色带加五组编号位一秒交代核心主张结构，主张文字全部留占位
shots.textZone: 右侧五条编号短句位「{selling_point_1}」至「{selling_point_5}」，顶部一条大标题带

shots.intent: 放大唇部干纹与上色卡纹的真实困扰，让买家先对号入座，再交给后面镜次解决
用同机位双栏交代同一色号由浅淡薄涂到满覆盖的叠涂逻辑，让买家自己选定浓度
以近地掠射的抹痕微距证明泥状配方的细碎颗粒与雾面成膜，取代任何口说主张
用三分格上妆动作把一物两用讲成可视化步骤，让买家想象自己的用法
shots.textZone: 顶部一条大标题位「{selling_point_3}」，三分格下方各一枚空白圆角标签位

shots.intent: 用双臂一排排矩形试色块完成选色决策，块下只留空白标签位不写色号
shots.textZone: 每枚色块下一条空白标签位，全套统一由生成时填字

shots.intent: 九格上唇效果墙完成最后选色，多肤色同光同裁切让色相差一眼可比
shots.textZone: 顶部标题带「{selling_point_2}」一格，九格下方各一枚空白圆角标签位

shots.intent: 以方格质地图墙集中交代雾面颗粒与虚边表现，替买家回答上嘴到底什么质感
以开箱全家福与全部留空的标贴位收口，消除到手内容与真伪顾虑而不编造任何资质

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for packshots, shade charts and texture walls, alternating with warm clay matte panels #E8CDB9 and one deep clay field #B0574E, deep berry rule lines #9E3B4A where a frame is needed; no lip or swatch hue is ever fixed, it is carried by the accent placeholder
style.direction: airy matte mud-texture lip colour commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line rules and blank rounded label pills outlined in deep berry #9E3B4A, oversized translucent numerals for the numbered claim list, no filled illustrative icons
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with fill card, butterfly beauty light on skin crops, skimming sweep light across matte texture, soft contact shadows only, never a wet specular on a velvet finish
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent airy matte mud-texture lip colour visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, warm clay #E8CDB9, terracotta clay #B0574E and deep berry rule lines #9E3B4A, with every lip and swatch hue carried by one accent placeholder; bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and fill card, butterfly light on skin crops, skimming sweep light across matte texture, soft contact shadows and no wet speculars; modern geometric sans-serif typography only; thin single-weight line rules, oversized translucent numerals and blank rounded label pills; stable open-tube anchor angle and scale with powdery feathered swipe edges; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no fixed lip shade hue across the set
no glossy finish on a matte product
style.presentationRules: one open-tube-with-applicator arrangement reused as the anchor at stable scale, formula always rendered as powdery velvet with feathered swipe edges, every lip and swatch colour carried by the accent placeholder instead of a fixed shade
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white sweep plus warm clay matte boards #E8CDB9 laid flat, overhead-friendly, no horizon and no table edge visible
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for every headline, oversized numeral and label line; all in-image copy is supplied at generation time as placeholders
